image_description: A wooden altar situated within a stone alcove featuring arched architecture. The altar consists of a raised rectangular structure with a flat top surface covered by a white cloth. It has a central cabinet-like base with paneling and a dark recessed niche. Flanking the altar are two tall, thin candlesticks with black candles. Above the altar is a large, ornate wooden frame resembling a Gothic arch or reredos, containing a reflective surface (mirror or glass). To the left, on a lower ledge, sits a small bottle and a box.
